target.title: fix(agents): resolve legacy modelstudio profile aliases
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #84081: legacy explicit auth profile ids like `modelstudio:default` fail to resolve after provider canonicalization to `qwen`, causing `No credentials found for profile "modelstudio:default"` even when `qwen:default` exists in the auth store.

## Summary

- Retry explicit legacy provider-prefixed profile ids through `resolveProviderIdForAuth` when direct lookup misses (resolver fallback in `model-auth.ts`).
- Add production Qwen manifest aliases: `modelstudio` → `qwen`, `qwencloud` → `qwen` in `extensions/qwen/openclaw.plugin.json` (required for the fallback to work outside mocked tests).
- Preserve explicit profile precedence: if `modelstudio:default` exists directly, it wins over `qwen:default`.

## Evidence

Repro path (before): store has only `qwen:default`, request `{ provider: "modelstudio", profileId: "modelstudio:default" }` → throws `No credentials found for profile "modelstudio:default"`.

After this patch (vitest, production manifest aliases + resolver fallback):

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/agents/model-auth.profiles.test.ts \
  src/agents/provider-auth-aliases.test.ts \
  src/agents/model-auth.modelstudio-profile-alias.test.ts \
  -t "84081|modelstudio profile" --run

 Test Files  6 passed (6)
      Tests  10 passed | 150 skipped (160)
```

Key assertions in `model-auth.modelstudio-profile-alias.test.ts` (no mocked alias map):
- `profileId: "modelstudio:default"` + store `{ "qwen:default": ... }` → resolves to `qwen:default`, key `qwen-key`
- store with both `modelstudio:default` and `qwen:default` → keeps explicit `modelstudio:default`

## Test plan

- [x] `provider-auth-aliases.test.ts` — reads bundled `extensions/qwen/openclaw.plugin.json`, asserts `modelstudio`/`qwencloud` → `qwen`
- [x] `model-auth.modelstudio-profile-alias.test.ts` — end-to-end `resolveApiKeyForProvider` with production manifest snapshot
- [x] `model-auth.profiles.test.ts` — alias fallback + explicit-profile precedence
- [ ] CI green

Fixes #84081
